run_mask_rcnn_node: run the MaskRCNNServer spin loop to detect COCO objects from a ROS camera feed
create_mask_rcnn_server: create a MaskRCNNServer instance with a pretrained Mask R-CNN ResNet50 FPN model on CUDA or CPU
run_mask_rcnn_spin: run the spin method to continuously capture images and print detected object labels and scores
show_tensor_images: show one or more PyTorch tensor images using matplotlib subplots with axis labels hidden
review_coco_categories: review the COCO_CATEGORIES list of 91 object class labels used by the Mask R-CNN model
